newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens may seek partner for SNI unit.
newsitem.headline: Siemens may seek partner for SNI unit.

text.p: German electrical engineering group Siemens AG was considering looking for a partner to help boost profitability at its Siemens Nixdorf Informationssysteme AG computer unit, chief executive Heinrich von Pierer said in an interview with the German newsweekly Der Spiegel.
Siemens Nixdorf, which barely turned a profit in 1995/96 after years of huge losses, was one of the units facing a profitability review, von Pierer said.
As part of a group-wide portfolio review, Siemens Nixdorf would face the questions "Are we big enough? Are we fast enough? Or do we need further cooperation?" he said.
Units unlikely to reach the goal of 15 percent return on capital by the year 2000 would be candiates for divestment or joint ventures, von Pierer said.
"A good part of the real and consequent globalisation still lies in front of us," he said.
